unit.title: Time
unit.blurb: Telling the time to the quarter hour, the months of the year, and how long things take in minutes and hours.
unit.subject: maths

O1.t: Read o'clock, half past, quarter past and quarter to.

O2.t: Know the months, and units of time: minutes, hours, days and weeks.

p: When the long hand points to **3**, it has gone a quarter of the way round: **quarter past**. When it points to **9**, there is a quarter to go: **quarter to** the next hour.
At quarter to 6 the short hand is nearly at 6, not yet past it. Say the hour that is coming next.

Half past has the long hand at 6.
The long hand is at 9, not 3.
The short hand is nearly at 6.

p: There are **12 months** in a year: January, February, March, April, May, June, July, August, September, October, November, December.
**60 minutes** = 1 hour. **24 hours** = 1 day. **7 days** = 1 week. Brushing your teeth takes minutes. A film takes hours.
